test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most suitable word.

The humour of the gods is cruel; or _____ they see more than we do.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Perhaps'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** most suitable word **to fill in the blank in the sentence is option 3: **"perhaps".**
 
• The word** "perhaps"** is used to express uncertainty or possibility.
 
• **It makes sense** in the given sentence because it introduces the idea that there might be another perspective (that the gods might see more than humans do) that could explain why the gods' humor seems cruel.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is: *'The humour of the gods is cruel; or **perhaps** they see more than we do.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options don't fit well in the context:
 
 
• **"Unlikely" **is used to indicate that something probably will not happen. In this context, it would not make sense to say "unlikely they see more than we do".
 
• **"Odds" **generally refers to the probability of a particular event. It would not make sense to say "odds they see more than we do".
 
• **"However"** is used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously. Here, it would not fit properly because there isn't a clear contrast being made in the sentence.
